name: Copertino
terms: Denominazione di Origine Controllata. The label names a precise area, and the wine is tested during production.

blurb.text: A Puglia denomination from six communes around Copertino and Galatina. Its wine is made from Negroamaro, with Malvasia Nera di Brindisi, Malvasia Nera di Lecce, Montepulciano and Sangiovese allowed up to 30% together.
